primary_fallback_wiring_mechanism_extrac.implication_for_UI15: Any structured-frontmatter convention introduced by this feature (e.g., 'mcp_primary:' / 'mcp_fallback:' fields on agent files) would be UNPRECEDENTED in the corpus. file_composition_evidence_for_UI8.interpretation: This repo is markdown-heavy (73.8%). The remaining source-code surface is concentrated in .claude/skills/auditing-*/scripts/ (Python audit scripts). Serena's symbol-level traversal value is therefore limited to those Python files; for the majority of the repo, Read/Grep on markdown is the natural primitive. GitNexus, being TS-first per ADR-0007 rationale, is also a thin fit for this repo's actual content — but per ADR-0007 + KB-codebase-research GitNexus is nonetheless declared canonical for the primary-tool slot. The UI-8 question (Serena vs no codebase MCP — narrowed in v3 to Serena's symbol-level value on a markdown-heavy repo) is sharper given this evidence.
